verdict.rationale: Gusto exposes an API and an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact directly with Embedded Payroll endpoints, and there is a contractor-payment preview endpoint (POST .../contractor_payment_groups/preview) plus GET unprocessed payrolls for review before submission — enabling agent-driven pre-run checks. However, there is no documented 'payroll preview' endpoint for regular employee payroll runs nor any built-in anomaly-detection/surfacing feature, so the anomaly-review capability would need to be built by the integrator rather than being a native product feature.
